values.note: recreation.gov rate table: STANDARD NONELECTRIC $38 a night for the 2026 and 2027 seasons, plus tax. Extra vehicles pay a per-vehicle, per-night fee. Run by the concessionaire Naventure.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234032/rates (season 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31: 'STANDARD NONELECTRIC' per_night 38) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234032 (rules hasTaxes; notice 'Extra vehicles will be charged a per-vehicle, per-night fee'), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234032 (Facilities: 'No hookups are available') + campsite catalog (all 64 campsites STANDARD NONELECTRIC), read 2026-10-21

values.note: recreation.gov sells 64 standard non-electric sites (RV, trailer or tent), all back-in; listed max vehicle lengths run 18-44 ft and 55 take 23 ft or more. The forest page says '67-unit campground accommodates tents and RVs up to 35 feet'; only 5 sites list more than 35 ft.

sites.source: recreation.gov campsite catalog for 234032 (Max Vehicle Length, Driveway Entry 'Back-In') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/florida/recreation/alexander-springs-recreation-area ('67-unit campground accommodates tents and RVs up to 35 feet'), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234032 ('Restrooms have flush toilets and showers. Camping necessities and firewood are available at a small general store'; amenities 'Drinking Water', 'Dump Station') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/florida/recreation/alexander-springs-recreation-area ('Concessionaire sells snacks, groceries, ice, charcoal, firewood'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 'All campsites require reservations by calling 1-877-444-6777 or at recreation.gov.' recreation.gov marks the 2-night weekend and 3-night holiday-weekend minimums 'soft': they may be relaxed for a same-day booking. Maximum 14 nights in a rolling 30 days. Check-in 2 pm, out 11 am, no early or late; the gate locks at 8 pm (Mar-Oct) or 6 pm (Nov-Mar) and late arrivals check in at the gatehouse the next morning. Up to 2 tents, 2 vehicles and 5 people per site. A day-use Vehicle Access Reservation is needed on summer weekends and holidays.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234032 (facility_rules minWeekendStay 2 'soft', minHolidayWeekendStay 3 'soft', maxStay 14 'Rolling 30 Days'; notices) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/florida/recreation/alexander-springs-recreation-area ('All campsites require reservations', 'Campsites are available by reservation only'), read 2026-10-21

summary: recreation.gov + Ocala NF page: confirmed $38 (2026 standard non-electric, plus tax), reservable on recreation.gov. Added no hookups (water/sewer false), 64 back-in sites to 44 ft (FS says RVs up to 35 ft), showers/flush toilets/water/dump/store, fcfs never, soft 2-night weekend / 3-night holiday minimums, 14-night max. Concessionaire is Naventure. No storm closure posted (only the boardwalk, closed for age and hurricane damage). AWH note kept. Not stated: window (inherited 180), season.
